title: Not Enough Weapons
description: Integrates many legendary and exotic weaponry and trinkets alongside punishing Bossfights and a reason to Explore your World.
body:
**CURRENTLY IN ALPHA**

Are you bored of lame Swords and Axes? Are you tired of the boring three bosses? Is the jungle temple too disappointing for both loot and excitement?

**Introducing _Not Enough Weapons_!** This mod integrates many **legendary** and **exotic** weaponry alongside punishing and epic **bossfights** with structures to explore. With over 40 weapons, 4 tool/armour sets, 12 structures, and 8 bossfights with 2 minibosses, you'll have tons of content to explore. Have Fun! (Comes with built-in compatibility with many mods like Ice and Fire CE, Aether, Mythic Metals etc. For more Info about the compatibility list and the mod itself check out the CurseForge and Modrinth page)
